newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end sharply down on heavy selling.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end sharply down on heavy selling.

text.p: * Main index hovers at 3,000 points support level
Manila shares fell sharply at the close on Tuesday, the main index falling 83.49 points, or 2.68 percent, to 3,037.54 on selling by local as well as foreign investors, traders said.
"We have a very depressed market today and its because of mixed local and foreign selling," said Teresa Lee, trader at Lippo Securities.
Decliners clobbered gainers 112 to 14 with 62 issues unchanged. All sectors fell.
Most index heavyweights closed down. Petron Corp fell 30 centavos to nine pesos while Meralco fell to 103 pesos from 106 pesos.
Fritz Aclan, research head at Dharmala Securities said the property sector also largely contributed to the weaker index. Ayala Land B shares closed 50 centavos lower to 29 pesos.
Asiatrust's debut price of 43.50 a share fell to 39.50 at the close, lower than its offering price of 39.88 pesos.
Aclan predicted the market will test the support level of 2,800 points tommorrow.
